title: Dove's Enderite
description: Ever thought netherite just isn't enough? This mod adds ENDERITE to satisfy your needs
body:
# Dove's Enderite
# 
Take Netherite one step further.

Dove's Enderite is a simple, vanilla-friendly Minecraft mod that introduces Enderite, a powerful new material found in the End. Mine Enderite Ore to obtain Enderite Ingots, then use them to upgrade your existing Netherite gear into an even stronger tier of equipment.

Designed to feel like a natural extension of Minecraft's progression, Enderite gives players a new reason to explore the End after defeating the Ender Dragon.

## ✨ Features
## 
⛏️ New Enderite Ore generated in the End.

💎 Mine ore for Enderite Ingots—no extra processing required.

⚒️ Upgrade Netherite gear into powerful Enderite equipment.

🛡️ Stronger tools and armor than Netherite.

🌍 Vanilla-friendly gameplay that fits naturally into Minecraft.

## 📖Guide
## 
Travel to the End.
Mine Enderite Ore to collect Enderite Ingots.
Use the upgrade recipe to transform your Netherite tools and armor into Enderite versions.
Enjoy your enhanced gear and continue your adventures with even greater power.
## 📦Content
## 
- Enderite Ore
- Enderite Ingot
- Enderite Sword
- Enderite Pickaxe  
- Enderite Axe  
- Enderite Shovel 
- Enderite Hoe 
- Enderite Helmet 
- Enderite Chestplate 
- Enderite Leggings
- Enderite Boots 
- Raw Enderite 
- Raw Enderite Block

## ⚙️Compatibility
## Minecraft: 1.21.8
Loader: Fabric
## 🎯Design
## 
Dove's Enderite is intentionally lightweight. Instead of adding dozens of new mechanics, it expands Minecraft's end-game progression with a single, balanced material that feels like it could have been part of the base game.
